name: docs-deployment-docker-md-02
yaml:
services:
  rift:
    image: zainalpour/rift-proxy:latest
    ports:
      - "2525:2525"
      - "4545:4545"
    volumes:
      - ./imposters.json:/imposters.json:ro
      - ./certs:/certs:ro
    command:
      - "--configfile"
      - "/imposters.json"
      - "--default-tls-cert"
      - "/certs/server.pem"
      - "--default-tls-key"
      - "/certs/server-key.pem"
